correctness.rationale: The order-simplex triangulation with prod a_i! simplices proves volume. Facets are exactly bottom coordinate, top coordinate, and adjacent-layer comparisons; their unit normals yield n(2+k sqrt2) surface/vol. Verified the four exhaustive ridge-face classes BB, BE, same-interface shared-endpoint EE, distinct-interface disjoint EE with normalized measure 2,2k sqrt2,k sqrt3,k(k-1). Overlapping adjacent-interface edges and disjoint same-interface comparisons force extra ties and are not ridges. Normal angles are pi/2 except same-interface sharing endpoint pi/3. In V_(n-2)=sum area(phi/2pi), the class totals yield formula for every k=r-1 and a_i>=2. Recomputed formula at r=2,3 and unequal profiles. Source SciPy convex-hull verifier independently checks 16 finite profiles (1356 ridges), not an exhaustive proof. Intrinsic volumes use standard Steiner convention kappa_2=pi.
